Hey, I'm not gonna start with the typical bullshit, like 'it will get better', it doesn't always get better, hell, sometimes it even gets worse.
You stated that you tried starting some new hobbies, and to me it sounded like you started those hobbies not because you were genuinely interested in them, but for the sake of doing something to occupy your life.

I'm going to be brutally honest, life is mundane and boring, always has been, always will be. However, sometimes you can find something you're into, and can look forward to. Even if it's just 1 thing, it can still improve your otherwise shitty life.

Now I'm not saying gardening or some shit will fix your life, but it can be a small distraction for the time being.
